description: Source code for the Attachments class managing attachment data in the Notesnook project, including methods for adding, removing, reading, and filtering attachments, as well as handling encryption and event subscriptions.

classes.name: Attachments
classes.description: Class managing attachment entities, including CRUD operations, filtering, encryption, and event handling within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the attachment collection.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new attachment, encrypts its key, and stores it in the collection.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a new encryption key for attachments.

methods.name: decryptKey
methods.description: Decrypts an attachment's encryption key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an attachment, optionally only locally, and detaches it from notes.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches an attachment from associated notes.

methods.name: canDetach
methods.description: Checks if an attachment can be detached from notes.

methods.name: ofNote
methods.description: Filters attachments associated with a specific note by type.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an attachment exists by hash.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and decrypts an attachment, returning data in specified format.

methods.name: attachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment by hash or ID.

methods.name: markAsUploaded
methods.description: Marks an attachment as uploaded.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the upload status of an attachment.

methods.name: markAsFailed
methods.description: Marks an attachment as failed with optional reason.

methods.name: cacheAttachments
methods.description: Queues attachments for offline download.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Encrypts data and saves as an attachment, returning its hash.

methods.name: downloadMedia
methods.description: Queues media attachments for download related to a note.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Deletes attachments marked as deleted after a grace period.

methods.name: totalSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of attachments based on a selector.

methods.name: encryptKey
methods.description: Encrypts a serialized key for storage.

methods.name: _getEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves user encryption key for attachments.
